narratives.Overview:
1. Write a deliberate RELEASING.md decision that Windows release Step 5 drops host vitest `--coverage` while keeping tip assertion pass/fail. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] with Refs #5026. "We always did" is not a rationale.
2. Implement the drop via a Step-5-only or host-lane-only seam (argv / script / env fork). Do not edit the shared `package.json` `"test": "vitest run --coverage"` in a way that removes instrumentation from GHA `pnpm run test`. GHA “Test with coverage (vitest)” remains coverage-of-record.
3. Coverage-of-record for the cut is a green GHA coverage run on the tip SHA being cut; the Step 5 tee cites that run id fail-closed. Merge-base prose alone is not enough. This path is not `--skip-ci`.
4. Record measured before/after Step 5 wall clock on the Windows host for the no-coverage lane.
5. Name the win32 residual explicitly (accept Ubuntu-only floor reader, or keep a narrower win32 coverage probe). Keep-coverage-plus-measure-only is outside this relieved harvest. GHA timeout / hang-detector stay on #5024; cheapen on #5027/#5028. Child of #5024.

Confirmed `git rev-parse HEAD` = `832f73ec9e9b5824f002d6ae52da5f3ec7bb5650`. Pin reads via `git show 832f73ec9e9b5824f002d6ae52da5f3ec7bb5650:<path>`. Envelope ignores comments with id > 5825992657. Stop 1 write-back is 5825992657.

Refutation target (Stop 1): Windows release Step 5 must run vitest with `--coverage` on the host because that local regeneration is the release correctness gate and the only legitimate coverage-of-record, so GHA coverage on the merge base cannot stand in and dropping `--coverage` would weaken the cut.

**Verdict: the refutation target does not survive** as that conjunction. Tip assertion pass/fail and coverage-of-record authority are already separate mechanisms; GHA already runs the same `pnpm run test` instrument under the same floor. What survives as residual is a narrower binding obligation if host `--coverage` drops: fail-closed tip-SHA GHA coverage citation, plus an explicit stance on win32-exercised paths.

## Tip correctness is not host coverage regeneration
sharpens-framing
Evidence: At the dispatch SHA, `package.json` `"test"` is `vitest run --coverage`; `ts:check-lane` `buildTestLaneCommand()` is `pnpm run test` plus reporters (`packages/core/src/ts-check-lane/progress.ts`); `run-lane.ts` tees `coverage: true` as a timeline condition, not as a separate correctness predicate. `vitest.config.ts` states the 75 floor is a collapse detector and puts per-change rigor on `verify:forward-coverage` (#3514), with thresholds identical on win32 and Linux CI (#3512). Release `--skip-ci` (`skip-ci-incident.ts`) skips the whole Step 5 suite and WARNs that npm ships untested — a different axis from keeping `vitest run` while dropping instrumentation.
Failure mode: Binding the target as written fuses tip pass/fail with local re-instrumentation, so any Step 5 that still fails closed on assertions while citing tip-SHA GHA for the floor would be framed as weakening the cut even when assertion correctness is intact.
Disposition: Before bind, split the premise into (1) tip assertion gate on the release host and (2) which artifact is coverage-of-record. Do not treat “drop `--coverage`” as synonymous with `--skip-ci`.

## Same-instrument GHA already exists; “only / cannot stand in” overclaims
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `.github/workflows/ci-lane.yml` job step `Test with coverage (vitest)` runs `pnpm run test` with `timeout-minutes: 20` (constants also name `CI_VITEST_COVERAGE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES = 20`). That is the same script and the same vitest-4 / v8 instrument as the host lane. `vitest.config.ts` / CHANGELOG #3512 lock one uniform floor with no platform carve-out. Inventory before new seams: local `coverage/` + auto-hatch (`pipeline.ts` / `auto-hatch.ts`), SHA suite stamp that may skip a re-run at the same clean HEAD (`suite-stamp.ts`; CI never trusts the laptop stamp), hang detector `RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS` 30m, and incident `--skip-ci`. No release seam yet cites a GHA run id as coverage-of-record (`docs/RELEASING.md` only separates the GHA 20m wall from the Windows hang detector).
Failure mode: Treating host regeneration as the sole legitimate record forces Windows re-instrumentation cost (#4591 spawn-heavy coverage wall clock) even when the tip SHA already has a green same-instrument GHA coverage run under the shared floor.
Disposition: Reject “only legitimate” and “cannot stand in.” If a successor lean drops host `--coverage`, it must add a fail-closed tip-SHA GHA coverage citation (run id on the tee) — merge-base prose alone is not enough — and must keep that path distinct from `--skip-ci`.

## Suite stamp already shows coverage-of-record is not “regenerate every cut”
footnote
Evidence: `packages/core/src/release/suite-stamp.ts` and Step 5 in `pipeline.ts` allow skipping the suite on a suite-stamp hit at the same clean HEAD after prior green or `PASS_WITH_DEBT`.
Failure mode: None for bind by itself; it undercuts the rhetoric that every cut’s correctness depends on a fresh local coverage regeneration.
Disposition: Keep as context when stating why host `--coverage` is optional cost rather than unique legitimacy.

## Win32-exercised path residual if Ubuntu is sole floor reader
footnote
Evidence: Runner and suite shape already special-case win32 (worker caps, coverage `.tmp` globalSetup, spawn-heavy project) while keeping the numeric floor identical (#3512). RELEASING.md routine-cut table still says green tip CI is a precondition, not a substitute for Step 5 coverage — policy prose defending today’s shape, not a second instrument.
Failure mode: A bind that drops host `--coverage` and trusts Ubuntu-only coverage without naming the residual could miss collapse on win32-only product branches the Ubuntu job never executes.
Disposition: Does not rescue the full target. A no-coverage host lean should either accept that residual explicitly or keep a narrower win32 coverage probe; it does not require keeping full host `--coverage` as the only coverage-of-record.

Road-not-taken: keep host `--coverage` forever and raise only the hang detector (#5024) / cheapen siblings (#5027/#5028). Rejected because the target’s legitimacy claim fails against the same-instrument GHA floor and the already-split collapse-detector role; wall-clock relief then stays trapped behind an overclaimed SoT. Steelman that would flip toward survival: show that win32-unique covered lines are material to the 75 floor on release tips, or that tip SHAs routinely lack a green GHA coverage run when cuts start — then host regeneration (or a Windows CI coverage required check) becomes necessary for the floor, not merely habitual.

Injection / swarm lens: N/A for concurrency/worktrees/prompts; the target does change which artifact has coverage authority, and that authority split is already handled in the sharpening findings above.

metadata.issueBody:
## Summary

Decide, deliberately, whether the Windows release Step 5 (`ts:check-lane`) needs to run vitest **with** coverage. The release gate needs pass/fail on the tip; the coverage number for the same merge base already exists from the Ubuntu GHA coverage run on the PR. Coverage is the multiplier on every CLI boot and every git spawn in the suite, so it is the largest single lever on Step 5 wall clock (#4591 diagnosed the 20m kill as spawn-heavy coverage wall clock, not fixtures).

Recommended child of #5024. This is a gate-shape decision, not a cheapen; it should be argued and recorded, not slipped in.

## Proposal

- Step 5 on Windows runs `vitest run` (no `--coverage`) as the correctness gate.
- Coverage-of-record for a release is the GHA coverage run on the merge base of the release tip. The release notes / tee cite that run id.
- If a coverage threshold must be enforced at cut time, Step 5 reads the GHA coverage summary for the merge base rather than regenerating it on the host.
- The GHA vitest coverage `timeout-minutes` stays a separate surface (as #5024 already holds).

## Acceptance criteria

- A written decision (RELEASING.md) on whether Step 5 runs with coverage, with the rationale either way. "We always did" is not a rationale.
- If decided no-coverage: `ts:check-lane` at Step 5 drops `--coverage`; the Step 5 tee records the GHA coverage run cited as coverage-of-record; a measured before/after Step 5 wall clock on the Windows host is recorded here.
- If decided keep-coverage: this issue closes with the reason and the measured cost of coverage (`--coverage` vs not, same host, same tip) so the cost is a known number rather than an assumption.
- CHANGELOG [Unreleased] records the outcome with Refs to this issue.

## Out of scope

- Raising the hang detector (that is #5024 itself).
- Changing which files are in the `spawn-heavy` project (separate cheapen children).
- Using `--skip-ci` as steady state.

## Related

Parent #5024. Refs #5022, #5023, #4591, #2652.
